Name: Gus Officiates Wedding
Author: mieukie
Description:
[color=#fff2cc][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]**IMPORTANT: [size=4]The new version of this mod is up as "Wedding Invitations" on my page, highly recommend you go for that one instead of this one for more customizability!! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46273][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46273](link to that)[/url][/size][/font][/size][/color]




[u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]LEWIS HATERS REJOICE!![/size][/font][/u]

With this mod, you can [b]have the bartender Gus officiate your wedding instead of Mayor Lewis[/b]. Gus delivers a slightly rewritten wedding speech, tweaked to make sense for him and to be a bit more friendly. 

In addition to kicking Mayor Lewis out of your wedding, [b]it also removes Clint & Pierre from the audience. [/b]This is because research has shown that the venn diagram between Lewis haters and Clint/Pierre haters is actually just a circle.

It's a very simple mod, and [b]nothing else is changed besides the scene/dialog in the actual wedding event[/b]. There is no extra content, only slight edits.

Downloads.Description: Have Gus officiate your wedding instead of Mayor Lewis. Also uninvites Clint, Lewis, and Pierre.
